statusText: Mapped policy state: WATCH. Delayed NQ is near the current overnight high during early Asia, while fresh chip strength and elevated oil increase directional sensitivity without yet establishing a persistent no-retracement path.
recommendation: Mapped policy state: WATCH. The principal conditional danger window remains 13:20-15:30 UTC around the U.S. cash open and Employer Costs release; escalation beyond WATCH requires observed persistent extension or failed repair.
headline: Early-Asia NQ strength lifts Tail to WATCH while oil keeps Stress extreme
body: Delayed NQ is 29,588.75 versus a 29,500.75 open and 29,538.75 prior close, close to the 29,599.50 overnight high. Fresh Finviz context shows NQ positive, VIX slightly lower, crude higher and strong semiconductor participation. The path is directional enough for WATCH, but no verified repeated failed-retracement sequence supports a 25%+ Tail state.

lookbackSummary: Across the preceding 24 UTC clock-hours, published Tail ranged from 16% to 32%. The peak occurred during the September 8 14:00 UTC downside extension; subsequent repair returned Tail to the low band, with the latest prior published hour at 18%.
outlookSummary: Early-Asia Tail is at WATCH because NQ is near its overnight high with supportive chip leadership. Risk should fade if meaningful retracements reappear. The next concentrated window is 13:20-15:30 UTC around the U.S. cash open and Employer Costs release, followed by an Apple-event checkpoint at 17:00 UTC.

forecast.analysis: Delayed NQ is 29,588.75 near the 29,599.50 overnight high after a 29,500.75 open. Early-Asia strength supports WATCH, but no repeated failed-retracement sequence is verified.

forecast.analysis: If the early-Asia high holds with shallow counter-moves, Tail stays WATCH; a normal pullback through the opening range would weaken the one-way interpretation.
Mid-Asia returns to low Tail if two-sided range trade develops. Repeated extensions after weak pullbacks would be the condition for renewed WATCH.
Asian trade stays low Tail if prior levels are revisited. Elevated crude remains a Stress amplifier unless NQ also shows persistent directional efficiency.
Late Asia remains low Tail under rotational trade. A clean carry into Europe with shrinking retracements would be the main deterioration signal.
The Asia-to-Europe handoff stays low Tail if overnight extremes fail to hold; persistence through the transition with shallow repair would raise concern.
Early Europe is a WATCH checkpoint because new liquidity can extend the overnight impulse; two-sided retracement would keep Tail below the block band.
European morning remains WATCH only if the opening impulse persists. Ordinary range expansion with meaningful pullbacks would keep the path non-pathological.
As U.S. participation builds, Tail stays WATCH because overnight positioning can reprice; the key condition is whether premarket impulses are repaired.
Late Europe remains WATCH if the overnight direction persists into U.S. premarket liquidity; a failed breakout or deeper retracement would lower Tail.
U.S. premarket risk rises into the cash open. Tail stays below 25% unless price holds near an extreme with broad cross-asset confirmation.
The 13:30 UTC cash open puts Tail at the top of WATCH. Opening-auction continuation matters; quick repair or two-sided rotation would invalidate escalation.
The 14:00 UTC Employer Costs release follows the cash open. Tail remains WATCH before data; only persistent post-release extension with failed repair would escalate it.
This is the main post-open/post-release second-leg checkpoint. Tail falls if retracements broaden and cross-assets stabilize; persistence would keep WATCH.
By 16:00 UTC, Tail should normalize if earlier U.S. catalysts produced two-sided trade; continued extension without meaningful repair would preserve WATCH.
Apple's 17:00 UTC special event is a technology checkpoint. WATCH reflects possible megacap repricing; escalation requires an observed one-way Nasdaq response.
After the Apple-event hour, Tail stays near WATCH only if technology follow-through is broad and pullbacks remain shallow; reversible moves would reduce risk.
The 19:00 UTC U.S. power hour is WATCH because late-session continuation can extend a dominant move; repeated retracements would keep the close contained.
After the 20:00 UTC cash close, Tail returns low if no unresolved one-way extreme remains. Oil and geopolitical risk continue to affect Stress.
The 21:00 UTC hour includes the equity-index futures maintenance break. Tail stays low unless fresh verified information creates a discontinuity for the reopen.
The 22:00 UTC futures reopen is WATCH because a gap can reveal new information; Tail stays below the block band unless extension persists and repair stays weak.
Post-reopen futures return to low Tail if the initial gap or impulse is contained. Extreme holding with shallow retracement would keep WATCH.
Late-evening futures remain low Tail if the reopen impulse stays contained; a directional gap holding near its extreme would be the main deterioration signal.
The next Asia session starts with a low-Tail baseline if the prior U.S. move is stable. PPI remains a future checkpoint outside this forecast horizon.
